gold: Disseminated Strongyloides stercoralis infection with ocular involvement (choroiditis)

selector.rationale: Decisive findings of disseminated aspergillosis and candidiasis in autopsy, along with laboratory tests revealing Aspergillus fumigatus, strongly support this diagnosis

rejected.label: Hyper-IgE syndrome
rejected.why: While patient has a recent diagnosis, it does not fully explain the acute presentation of altered mental status, fever, and respiratory failure

rejected.label: Ocular larva migrans
rejected.why: Less specific evidence and lower score compared to ocular toxocariasis
